messages:
Maria: quick follow-up from the postmortem — I built an action heatmap of recurring pages and noisy signals, sharing next steps. link: https://internal.redwood/oops/heatmap :heatmap:
AJ: saw it, nice. what's the top-3 noisy alerts we're tackling this sprint?
Maria: top3 = kvcache-threshold-flap, auth-db-timeout spikes, and model-serving-ooms. each has different remediation owners.
Sami: I can take kvcache-threshold-flap. will investigate whether it's a threshold issue or upstream spike. ETA EOD Thu. :thumbsup:
Kevin: I'll pick up model-serving-ooms. thinking we need a combination of bucketed thresholds + short-term autoscale bump.
AJ: who owns auth-db-timeout?
Maria: @Kevin volunteered last retro but happy to hand to others. AJ — are you ok to coordinate the DB-side thresholds?
AJ: I can coordinate. will sync with db team tomorrow. aiming for proposed thresholds + runbook by next Tue.
Maria: great. For context I ran a quick dedupe analysis — ~42% of pages from kvcache are duplicates within 3m. Suggest we add a dedupe window and group key on request-prefix.
Sami: suggested suppression rule snippet I tested locally:
```
# dedupe pseudo-config
policy_id: kvcache-dedupe-v1
group_by: request_prefix
window: 3m
max_pages: 1
action: suppress
```
Sami: if that looks sane I'll push as a canary to nocturne cluster.
Kevin: also recommending a soft-fail threshold so we don't hide true incidents — maybe alert at 90% suppressed for 10m.
Maria: agreed. add a metric so we can detect over-suppression: `suppression_rate > 0.9 for 10m` -> pager to oncall-sysops.
triage-bot: Note: created task INF-4821 -> "kvcache dedupe + suppression canary" assigned to Sami, due 2026-04-02.
AJ: for paging policy, propose: critical -> 2 pings immediate, then escalate; high -> 1 ping + 15m snooze if repeated within window. I'll draft policy text.
Maria: please include rollback criteria and who to ping if suppression causes missed alert.
Sami: putting a canary config in `deploy/canaries/kvcache-dedupe.yaml` then running smoke through synthetic workload. will post results here.
Kevin: for model-serving-ooms I'm adding a short-term quota bump for critical models and an infra ticket to increase per-pod mem 10% for the next 48h. will link infra ticket when created.
AJ: timeline recap? Sami EOD Thu for investigation + canary. AJ will draft paging policy by Mon. Kevin infra + mitigation by Fri. Maria will own follow-up metrics and runbook updates.
Maria: yep. action owners: Sami (kvcache dedupe), AJ (paging policy + thresholds), Kevin (model OOM mitigations + auth-db followup coordination with AJ). I'll track status in the postmortem action sheet.
Kevin: small ask — can we add a recurring weekly alert-sweep for top-10 noisy rules and a 1h triage slot on Wed? helps keep entropy down.
Maria: love that. AJ can you add a calendar invite for weekly 30m triage?
AJ: added: "Alert Noise Triage — Wed 09:00" and shared board link.
Sami: will post canary results and a diff of the suppression rule once deployed.
Maria: thanks everyone. if anyone hits blockers ping me or @oncall rotation. will update the action sheet before EOD. :sparkles:
